_readme: Temporary clade image selections, reviewed for source, identity and licence on 2026-10-10.
Review later: all 40 image choices remain provisional. Read each reviewNote and docs/clade-images-review.md.
Image selection is independent of the clade description. Broader article text is never approved by an image override.
Representative members are descendants in the current Dinozoa tree; captions identify the depicted animal.
The 13 redirected-article entries deliberately reuse the previously cached article image as a temporary fix.
Images remain on Wikimedia Commons with creator, original-file and licence links displayed in the game.
Update imageUrl, fallbackUrl, imageTitle, artist, fileUrl, licenseName, licenseUrl and caption together when replacing an image.
